authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/yamaha/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/yamaha/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the data list's MIDI parameter change tables, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Parameter change: F0 43 1n 7F 1B <address> <data> F7, n the device number (the deviceId variable is 1n, 10H for device number 1); bulk dumps are asked for with 2n and answered with 0n, both taken as device number 1.
Identity: the reply the data list prints, F0 7E 7F 06 02 43 00 41 4A 06 00 00 00 7F F7.

The data list prints the model ID as 7F and a second byte for each model (1A for the CP4 STAGE, 1B for the CP40 STAGE), and the identity's family code likewise (49 06, 4A 06): this profile takes this model's.
Left out, the headers and footers of the bulk dumps, not settings: BULK CONTROL.

Left out, several settings packed in one byte, a bit each: Performance Common: Insertion Part Sw (36 00 1D), Zone 1: Transmit Bank Select Transmit Program Change Transmit Volume Transmit Pan (3A 00 0C), Zone 1: Transmit PB Transmit MW Transmit FC1 Transmit FC2 Transmit FS Transmit Sus (3A 00 0D), Zone 2: Transmit Bank Select Transmit Program Change Transmit Volume Transmit Pan (3A 01 0C), Zone 2: Transmit PB Transmit MW Transmit FC1 Transmit FC2 Transmit FS Transmit Sus (3A 01 0D), Zone 3: Transmit Bank Select Transmit Program Change Transmit Volume Transmit Pan (3A 02 0C), Zone 3: Transmit PB Transmit MW Transmit FC1 Transmit FC2 Transmit FS Transmit Sus (3A 02 0D), Zone 4: Transmit Bank Select Transmit Program Change Transmit Volume Transmit Pan (3A 03 0C), Zone 4: Transmit PB Transmit MW Transmit FC1 Transmit FC2 Transmit FS Transmit Sus (3A 03 0D).

parameters.name: Master Tune
parameters.description: 4 bytes: 1st bit 3-0: bit 15-12 2nd bit 3-0: bit 11-8 3rd bit 3-0: bit 7-4 4th bit 3-0: bit 3-0. Printed: -102.4 – +102.3 [cent].

parameters.name: EQ Frequency1
parameters.description: When EQ Shape1 is set to “peak,” the range is 63Hz (0x0A) – 2.0kHz. Printed: 32Hz – 2.0kHz.

parameters.name: Performance Name
parameters.description: 10 characters, one per address from 36 00 00, 32 – 127 (ASCII). Read from the bulk dump; not written, since a parameter change carries one character.

parameters.name: Tempo
parameters.description: 2 bytes, the high 7 bits first. Printed: 5 – 300.

parameters.name: Receive Channel
parameters.description: This parameter can be set only via MIDI. Printed: 1..16, off (7F).
